relevant_laws.quote: Except as provided in subsection 3, a person shall not drive a motorcycle, moped or trimobile abreast of or overtake or pass another vehicle within the same traffic lane. Motorcycles and mopeds may, with the consent of the drivers, be operated no more than two abreast in a single traffic lane.
relevant_laws.notes: Fixed road overtaking permits same-lane pass and same-lane abreast variants; consent and subsection 3 remain independently sourced.
